title: Underground infrastructure at the Nevada Test Site for craft and retrieval teams

tellings.quote: the underground infrastructure is there to to house Alfred O'Donnell's craft

plain: Underground facilities at the Nevada Test Site, the government's old nuclear testing ground, exist to house the craft linked to a man named Alfred O'Donnell, according to an online researcher who goes by UAPGerb. He tells Michels this without naming a source, also bringing in Bob Lazar, a man long tied to claims about secret craft in Nevada, and if true it would put hidden hangars and retrieval teams beneath the test site.
